method: Official MahaRERA public search (maharera.maharashtra.gov.in/projects-search-result, by project name) for identity, registration number, promoter and pincode. Listing portals (housiey, propertypistol, cityair, keystone, houssed, saeloun, gharpe) as secondary sources only. MahaRERA project detail pages (maharerait…/public/project/view/<id>) render in JavaScript and could not be read automatically, so completion dates and carpet areas are NOT verified from MahaRERA.

rules.apply: Only items with status 'verified' AND action 'set' are applied, and only to the allow-listed fields. Everything else is for human review.
rules.title_note: Project URLs are built from the title (/projects/<title>-<locality>-<number>). Correcting a title changes the URL, so title fixes are proposed as a 'Registered name' custom field, never applied automatically.
